message:
release: 0.2.151 -- paste on demand, hardened: copies keep their order, a late remote copy never lands on a newer one here

PC only. Follows Codex's post-release review of 0.2.149/0.2.150 (paste-on-demand r5-r9, 6177d39..85dcee2):
- which copy is newer is decided against a fresh host baseline taken right after each copy here, fixed per
  paste (a concurrent remote copy within that window counts as earlier -- a priority rule, not a clock);
- remote text and remote files are written here only if no newer copy was made here meanwhile; a file offer
  carries the generation it was asked in (msg 86/87, Pong 0x10000) and the helper publishes only if the
  clipboard revision is unchanged (helper pipe msg 18, kPipeVersion 2); an older host (incl. 0.2.150) gets
  no unordered file write here -- "update the remote PC" instead;
- keys typed between two pastes keep their order; no key is left held when a paste fails or the queue overflows;
- copying here no longer waits on the file helper (non-blocking identity snapshot);
- a use-after-free in the new offer parser found in review (ASan-confirmed) is fixed before any release.
Verified: Codex source OK on 85dcee2; verifier's independent build with its own 0.2.150 binaries for the
mixed-version cases -- paste e2e 303/0 x3, file_copy_helper 154/0 x2, file_copy_net 325, clip_image 34,
release_all, xbutton, pure 10; main integration 15 tests (paste e2e rerun after a user-clipboard move by an
unidentified process) and the APK compile. Not verified: two real PCs.

Product: version only (PC 0.2.150 -> 0.2.151; APK stays 0.2.26). Test: none. Docs: none.
